ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.curves.FxForwardCurveDefinition

Generates the Cross Currency curves for the definitions provided

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.curves.FxForwardCurveDefinition.

Syntax

FxForwardCurveDefinition(
    *,
    cross_currency_definitions: list[CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing] | None = None,
    curve_tenors: OptStrings = None,
    interest_rate_curve_definitions: list[ZcCurveDefinition] | None = None,
    base_currency: OptStr = None,
    base_index_name: OptStr = None,
    is_non_deliverable: OptBool = None,
    pivot_currency: OptStr = None,
    pivot_index_name: OptStr = None,
    quoted_currency: OptStr = None,
    quoted_index_name: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
cross_currency_definitions list[CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing] | None No None
curve_tenors OptStrings No None List of user-defined curve tenors or dates to be computed.

base_currency OptStr No None
base_index_name OptStr No None
